scripts.//build: ⚠ NOT a `prebuild` lifecycle script — pnpm does not run pre/post scripts by default, so it would silently never fire and the check would look present while doing nothing. Chained here, where it cannot be skipped.
scripts.//test:phone: ⚠ Needs a build (it checks what ships) and a Chromium: `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` once, or CHROMIUM_PATH at one you already have. Not in `check` because of that download; CI runs it as its own step.
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

pnpm.//: pnpm refuses to guess which packages may run lifecycle hooks, and it is right to: a postinstall is arbitrary code executing during an install. esbuild's downloads its platform binary and vitest needs it, so it is declared here explicitly rather than allowed globally. Same reasoning as the file this replaces, web/pnpm-workspace.yaml.
